```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(modelr)
library(rlang)
library(ggeffects)
library(ggforce)
library(writexl)
library(plotly)

data_dir <- 'data/_processed/'

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "../..")

```

# Read in data

```{r}

# read in data
wca <- read_csv("data/_processed/wca_filtered_annotated.csv") |>
  rename_with(~str_remove_all(.x, '_bill')) |>
  rename(dbh = dbh_cm,
         height = height_m,
         age = tree_age_yrs,
         spp = scientific_name_clean,
         date = date_worked,
         lat = latitude,
         lon = longitude)

wca_age <- wca %>%
group_by(spp, tree_id) |>
  filter(n() >= 2, !is.na(age)) |>
  mutate(
    delta_days  = as.numeric(difftime(date, lag(date), units = "days")),
    delta_yrs   = delta_days / 365.25,
    delta_dbh_cm = dbh - lag(dbh),
    dbh_start_cm = lag(dbh),
    dbh_end_cm = dbh
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(growth_rate = delta_dbh_cm/delta_yrs,
         growth_flag = ifelse(growth_rate > 4 | growth_rate == 0, T, F),
         delta_flag = ifelse(delta_yrs > 2, F, T),
         delta_dbh_flag = ifelse(delta_dbh_cm > 0, F, T)
         ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(delta_yrs),
         is.finite(delta_yrs), is.finite(delta_dbh_cm))

spp_of_interest <- unique(wca_age$spp)

wca_age_clean <- wca_age %>% filter(growth_flag == F, delta_flag == F, delta_dbh_flag == F) |>
  mutate(log_growth_rate = log(delta_dbh_cm)/log(delta_yrs)) %>% 
  filter(spp %in% spp_of_interest,
         dbh > 2.54) |>
  group_by(tree_id) |>
  slice_sample(n = 1) |>
  ungroup()


wca_clean <- wca_age %>% filter(spp %in% spp_of_interest,
         dbh > 2.54) |>
  group_by(tree_id) |>
  slice_sample(n = 1) |>
  ungroup()

wca_growth_rates <- wca %>%
group_by(spp, tree_id) |>
  filter(n() >= 2) |>
  mutate(
    delta_days  = as.numeric(difftime(date, lag(date), units = "days")),
    delta_yrs   = delta_days / 365.25,
    delta_dbh_cm = dbh - lag(dbh),
    dbh_start_cm = lag(dbh),
    dbh_end_cm = dbh
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(growth_rate = delta_dbh_cm/delta_yrs,
         growth_flag = ifelse(growth_rate > 4 | growth_rate == 0, T, F),
         delta_flag = ifelse(delta_yrs > 2, F, T),
         delta_dbh_flag = ifelse(delta_dbh_cm > 0, F, T)
         ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(delta_yrs),
         is.finite(delta_yrs), is.finite(delta_dbh_cm))

```

# Generate unfiltered model


```{r}

# drop anomalies, records missing age, and species with fewer than 30 observations, trees younger than 1 year or with implied mean growth rate of > 4 cm per year
min_n <- 30
dbh_age_data <- wca_clean |>
  filter(age_dbh_height_is_anom == FALSE, !is.na(age)) |>
  add_count(spp, name = "n_spp") |>
  filter(n_spp >= 30) |>
  select(-n_spp)

# fit random slope and intercept model
fit.lme <- lmer(log(dbh) ~ log(age) + (1 + log(age) | spp),
                data = dbh_age_data,
                control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                      optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e6)))



```


# Generate unfiltered species level BLUPs

```{r}

## species-level and genus-level coefficient blups -----------------------------

# species-level blups (conditional coefficients: fixed + random)
sp_blups <- coef(fit.lme)$spp %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("spp") %>%
  rename(intercept = `(Intercept)`, slope = `log(age)`)

# full covariance of blups/blues, conditional on variance parameter estimates
V <- vcov(fit.lme, full = TRUE)

# bookkeeping for random effects
p     <- length(fixef(fit.lme))   # number of fixed effects
Gp    <- getME(fit.lme, "Gp")     # block pointers into b (0-based)
cnms  <- getME(fit.lme, "cnms")   # term names per RE grouping factor
flist <- getME(fit.lme, "flist")  # grouping factors (levels/order)

# fixed-effect index in V
i_beta <- function(term) {
  i <- match(term, colnames(V))
  stopifnot(!is.na(i))
  i
}

# random-effect index in V
i_re <- function(grp, lvl, term) {
  j <- match(grp, names(cnms))
  stopifnot(!is.na(j))

  levs <- levels(flist[[j]])
  il <- match(lvl, levs)
  it <- match(term, cnms[[j]])
  stopifnot(!is.na(il), !is.na(it))

  nc <- length(cnms[[j]])
  start <- p + Gp[j] + 1  # convert 0-based pointer to 1-based V index
  start + (il - 1) * nc + (it - 1)
}

# SE for sum of components
se_sum <- function(idxs) {
  v <- V[idxs, idxs, drop = FALSE]
  sqrt(sum(v))
}

# species-level SEs for conditional coefficients (beta + b_spp)
grp_name <- "spp"
spp_levels <- levels(flist[[grp_name]])

sp_full_se <- tibble(
  spp = spp_levels,
  intercept_se = sapply(spp_levels, \(s)
                        se_sum(c(i_beta("(Intercept)"),
                                 i_re(grp_name, s, "(Intercept)")))),
  slope_se = sapply(spp_levels, \(s)
                    se_sum(c(i_beta("log(age)"),
                             i_re(grp_name, s, "log(age)"))))
)

# join with point estimates
sp_blups_se <- sp_blups %>%
  left_join(select(sp_full_se, spp, intercept_se, slope_se),
            by = "spp")

# population-level estimates with SEs
blues_tbl <- tibble(
  term = c("intercept", "slope"),
  estimate = c(unname(fixef(fit.lme)["(Intercept)"]),
               unname(fixef(fit.lme)["log(age)"])),
  se = c(sqrt(V[i_beta("(Intercept)"), i_beta("(Intercept)")]),
         sqrt(V[i_beta("log(age)"),    i_beta("log(age)")]))
)

# coefficient list
coef_list <- list(
  species = sp_blups_se,
  population = blues_tbl
)



```


# Generate filtered age model


```{r}


# drop anomalies, records missing age, and species with fewer than 30 observations, trees younger than 1 year or with implied mean growth rate of > 4 cm per year
min_n <- 30
dbh_age_data_clean <- wca_age_clean |>
  filter(age_dbh_height_is_anom == FALSE, !is.na(age)) |>
  add_count(spp, name = "n_spp") |>
  filter(n_spp >= 30) |>
  select(-n_spp)

# fit random slope and intercept model
fit.lme_clean <- lmer(log(dbh) ~ log(age) + (1 + log(age) | spp),
                data = dbh_age_data_clean,
                control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                      optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e6)))



```


# Generate filtered species level BLUPs

```{r}

## species-level and genus-level coefficient blups -----------------------------

# species-level blups (conditional coefficients: fixed + random)
sp_blups_clean <- coef(fit.lme_clean)$spp %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("spp") %>%
  rename(intercept = `(Intercept)`, slope = `log(age)`)

# full covariance of blups/blues, conditional on variance parameter estimates
V_cl <- vcov(fit.lme_clean, full = TRUE)

# bookkeeping for random effects
p_cl     <- length(fixef(fit.lme_clean))
Gp_cl    <- getME(fit.lme_clean, "Gp")
cnms_cl  <- getME(fit.lme_clean, "cnms")
flist_cl <- getME(fit.lme_clean, "flist")

# fixed-effect index in V_cl
i_beta_cl <- function(term) {
  i <- match(term, colnames(V_cl))
  stopifnot(!is.na(i))
  i
}

# random-effect index in V_cl
i_re_cl <- function(grp, lvl, term) {
  j <- match(grp, names(cnms_cl))
  stopifnot(!is.na(j))

  levs <- levels(flist_cl[[j]])
  il <- match(lvl, levs)
  it <- match(term, cnms_cl[[j]])
  stopifnot(!is.na(il), !is.na(it))

  nc <- length(cnms_cl[[j]])
  start <- p_cl + Gp_cl[j] + 1
  start + (il - 1) * nc + (it - 1)
}

# SE for sum of components
se_sum_cl <- function(idxs) {
  v <- V_cl[idxs, idxs, drop = FALSE]
  sqrt(sum(v))
}

# species-level SEs for conditional coefficients (beta + b_spp)
grp_name_cl <- "spp"
spp_levels_cl <- levels(flist_cl[[grp_name_cl]])

sp_full_se_cl <- tibble(
  spp = spp_levels_cl,
  intercept_se = sapply(spp_levels_cl, \(s)
                        se_sum_cl(c(i_beta_cl("(Intercept)"),
                                    i_re_cl(grp_name_cl, s, "(Intercept)")))),
  slope_se = sapply(spp_levels_cl, \(s)
                    se_sum_cl(c(i_beta_cl("log(age)"),
                                i_re_cl(grp_name_cl, s, "log(age)"))))
)

# join with point estimates
sp_blups_se_clean <- sp_blups_clean %>%
  left_join(select(sp_full_se_cl, spp, intercept_se, slope_se),
            by = "spp")

# population-level estimates with SEs
blues_tbl_clean <- tibble(
  term = c("intercept", "slope"),
  estimate = c(unname(fixef(fit.lme_clean)["(Intercept)"]),
               unname(fixef(fit.lme_clean)["log(age)"])),
  se = c(sqrt(V_cl[i_beta_cl("(Intercept)"), i_beta_cl("(Intercept)")]),
         sqrt(V_cl[i_beta_cl("log(age)"),    i_beta_cl("log(age)")]))
)

# coefficient list
coef_list_clean <- list(
  species = sp_blups_se_clean,
  population = blues_tbl_clean
)



```


# Visualize models and data

```{r}

# --- set species name here ---

spp <- unique(sp_blups_clean$spp)

sp <- spp[32]

# background points: all flagged observations for this species
bg_sp <- wca_age %>%
  filter(spp == sp, dbh > 2.54) %>%
  mutate(flag_label = if_else(
    growth_flag | delta_flag | delta_dbh_flag, "flagged", "retained"
  ))

bg_sp_mean_growth <- wca_growth_rates %>%
  filter(spp == sp, dbh > 2.54,
         growth_flag == F,
         delta_dbh_flag == F,
         delta_flag == F) %>%
  select(growth_rate) %>%
  .$growth_rate %>%
  median()

bg_sp_median_log_gr <- wca_age_clean %>%
  filter(spp == sp, dbh > 2.54,
         growth_flag == F,
         delta_dbh_flag == F,
         delta_flag == F) %>%
  pull(log_growth_rate) %>%
  median(na.rm = TRUE)

bg_sp_growth_adj <- wca_age %>%
  filter(spp == sp, dbh > 2.54,
         growth_flag == F,
         delta_dbh_flag == F,
         delta_flag == F) %>%
  mutate(dbh_class = case_when(
    dbh <= 10  ~ "0-10",
    dbh <= 25  ~ "10-25",
    TRUE       ~ ">25"
  )) %>%
  group_by(dbh_class) %>%
  summarise(mean_gr = mean(growth_rate, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pull(mean_gr) %>%
  mean(na.rm = TRUE)

# helper: build species-level prediction curve on original scale
make_pred <- function(blups_se, blues, data_for_range) {
  sb <- filter(blups_se, spp == sp)
  if (nrow(sb) == 0) return(NULL)

  x_rng <- data_for_range %>%
    filter(spp == sp) %>%
    summarise(xmin = min(log(age), na.rm = TRUE),
              xmax = max(log(age), na.rm = TRUE))

  b0_pop <- blues$estimate[blues$term == "intercept"]
  b1_pop <- blues$estimate[blues$term == "slope"]

  tibble(x = seq(x_rng$xmin, x_rng$xmax, length.out = 200)) %>%
    mutate(
      fit      = sb$intercept + sb$slope * x,
      se       = sqrt(sb$intercept_se^2 + x^2 * sb$slope_se^2),
      lo       = fit - 1.96 * se,
      hi       = fit + 1.96 * se,
      pop_fit  = b0_pop + b1_pop * x,
      age_orig     = exp(x),
      fit_orig     = exp(fit),
      lo_orig      = exp(lo),
      hi_orig      = exp(hi),
      pop_fit_orig = exp(pop_fit)
    )
}

pred_uf <- make_pred(sp_blups_se,       blues_tbl,       dbh_age_data)
pred_cl <- make_pred(sp_blups_se_clean, blues_tbl_clean, dbh_age_data_clean)

```

## Plot 1: filtered and unfiltered models

```{r}

p_base <- ggplot(bg_sp, aes(x = age, y = dbh)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = flag_label), alpha = 0.7, size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c(retained = "grey40", flagged = "orange")
  ) +
  # unfiltered model ribbon + lines
  { if (!is.null(pred_uf)) list(
    geom_ribbon(data = pred_uf,
                aes(x = age_orig, ymin = lo_orig, ymax = hi_orig),
                alpha = 0.15, fill = "firebrick", inherit.aes = FALSE),
    geom_line(data = pred_uf,
              aes(x = age_orig, y = pop_fit_orig),
              color = "firebrick", linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dashed", inherit.aes = FALSE),
    geom_line(data = pred_uf,
              aes(x = age_orig, y = fit_orig),
              color = "firebrick", linewidth = 0.7, inherit.aes = FALSE)
  )} +
  # filtered model ribbon + lines
  { if (!is.null(pred_cl)) list(
    geom_ribbon(data = pred_cl,
                aes(x = age_orig, ymin = lo_orig, ymax = hi_orig),
                alpha = 0.15, fill = "steelblue", inherit.aes = FALSE),
    geom_line(data = pred_cl,
              aes(x = age_orig, y = pop_fit_orig),
              color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dashed", inherit.aes = FALSE),
    geom_line(data = pred_cl,
              aes(x = age_orig, y = fit_orig),
              color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.7, inherit.aes = FALSE)
  )} +
  labs(
    title = sp,
    subtitle = "red = unfiltered model  |  blue = filtered model  |  dashed = population",
    x = "Age (years)", y = "DBH (cm)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.1),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

p_base

```

# Save species plots: filtered model + median growth rate

```{r}

out_dir <- "_img/age-dbh/ind_plots"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (sp in unique(sp_blups_clean$spp)) {

  bg_sp_loop <- wca_age %>%
    filter(spp == sp, dbh > 2.54) %>%
    mutate(flag_label = if_else(
      growth_flag | delta_flag | delta_dbh_flag, "flagged", "retained"
    ))

  median_gr <- wca_growth_rates %>%
    filter(spp == sp, dbh > 2.54,
           growth_flag == FALSE,
           delta_dbh_flag == FALSE,
           delta_flag == FALSE) %>%
    pull(growth_rate) %>%
    median(na.rm = TRUE)

  pred_cl_loop <- make_pred(sp_blups_se_clean, blues_tbl_clean, dbh_age_data_clean)

  if (is.null(pred_cl_loop) || is.na(median_gr)) next

  p_loop <- ggplot(bg_sp_loop, aes(x = age, y = dbh)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = flag_label), alpha = 0.7, size = 1.5) +
    scale_color_manual(
      name = NULL,
      values = c(retained = "grey40", flagged = "orange")
    ) +
    geom_ribbon(data = pred_cl_loop,
                aes(x = age_orig, ymin = lo_orig, ymax = hi_orig),
                alpha = 0.15, fill = "steelblue", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_line(data = pred_cl_loop,
              aes(x = age_orig, y = pop_fit_orig),
              color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dashed", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_line(data = pred_cl_loop,
              aes(x = age_orig, y = fit_orig),
              color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.7, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 2.54, slope = median_gr, color = "forestgreen") +
    labs(
      title = sprintf("%s  |  median growth rate: %.2f cm/yr", sp, median_gr),
      subtitle = "blue = filtered model  |  dashed = population  |  green = median growth rate",
      x = "Age (years)", y = "DBH (cm)"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.1),
      legend.position = "top"
    )

  fname <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(gsub(" ", "_", sp), ".png"))
  ggsave(fname, p_loop, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 150)
}

```
